title: I♥️MOHAMMAD S. W #love #mohammad
description:
🔥 Ek chhota sa banner, lekin ek bada sach! 🔥
Unhone socha yeh sirf ek naam hai… lekin yeh naam hai jiske liye tareekh me hazaron jang ladi gayi. 🕌💪

💥 Shayd unhe pata nahi tha, yeh naam hai jiske liye Muslim apni jaan bhi de sakte hain aur is par fakhar karte hain.
💥 Sirf ek banner gira, lekin Muslimon ne ‘I ❤️ Muhammad ﷺ’ ke naare lagate hue crore banner utha diye.

🙏 Yeh sirf ek naam nahi, yeh hamara imaan hai.
✨ Isliye hum sirf ek martaba nahi, zindagi bhar ke liye kehte rahenge – I ❤️ Muhammad ﷺ

👇 Aapke liye bhi comment khali hai, apna jazba dikhaiye! ❤️
